fusions.name: Flicked Pebble
fusions.desc: Flicks a pebble that deals 4 damage, then hops to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Lift the Purse
fusions.desc: A quick tongue-snatch that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Vine Swing
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 15% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sticky Fingers
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
